_comment: Units the release wants installed on every Linux machine (jobs-manifest, B案). publish.py packs each listed unit file from blave_agent/systemd/ into the tarball; control/updater.py applies them idempotently every tick (install → daemon-reload → enable --now). SECURITY: the updater runs as root but refuses any .service without User=blaveagent or whose ExecStart leaves /opt/blave-agent — a compromised release channel must stay at agent privilege, never become root. Windows is skipped (schtasks scheduling ships separately).
_comment_windows: Scheduled tasks the release wants registered on Windows (schtasks stand-in for the timers; the event chain is the blave-agent-watcher NSSM service, provision-owned). script is relative to C:\blave-agent; bin: venv|system. Control-plane tasks (updater/watchdog/firstboot) stay provision-owned and NEVER appear here. provision.ps1 registers the same definitions at build time as bootstrap; on drift, this manifest wins.
